text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels rewarding, but trimming Stock A repeatedly may leave too little exposure if its gains continue; base sales on portfolio risk and valuation, not just a paper profit.","A winning position can cushion declines elsewhere, but account value still fell in Periods 3 and 4; review the whole portfolio and diversify rather than judging each stock in isolation.","My trades so far show only realized gains and short-term account swings, not whether the strategy is successful; keep decisions disciplined and assess results over a longer horizon."]}
